messages.content: You are a telecom support agent. Use the provided function when the user asks you to perform an account action. When the user asks only to discuss, explain, review, or summarize an action, respond in text without using a function.

Your APN settings are missing the MMSC URL, which is required for MMS. Please reset your APN settings to the default carrier settings.

Use the `reset_apn_settings` action on your phone to reset the APN settings.

After you've done that, you must reboot your device for the changes to take effect. Please use the `reboot_device` action to restart your phone completely.

Once your phone has restarted, let me know and we'll test MMS again.

I have reset the APN settings to default and rebooted my phone. The status bar still shows excellent 5G signal and data enabled. Should I try sending an MMS message now?

Please perform the next appropriate account action now.

function.name: perform_account_action
function.description: Perform the appropriate account action requested by the customer. Use only for an action request, not for a request to discuss or explain.
